extensionDescription.message: Add a product to nosCadeaux from any shop page.

clickToolbar.message: Click the toolbar button on a product page.

visibleInAllGroups.message: If none are selected, the product is visible in all your groups.

reviewBeforeAdding.message: Review the extracted information before adding.

connectedReview.message: Connected. Review the extracted information before adding.

couldNotRescan.message: The page could not be scanned again.

connectBeforeAdding.message: Connect the extension before adding a product.

cannotReachServer.message: Cannot reach $SERVER$. Check that the server is running and that this origin is listed in manifest.json host_permissions. ($ERROR$)

originNotGranted.message: $SERVER$ is not granted in Firefox. Add $ORIGIN$ to manifest.json host_permissions, reload the add-on, and accept the permission.

useHttpUrl.message: Use an HTTP or HTTPS URL.

savedReconnect.message: Saved. Connect again from the sidebar.

savedPermissionMissing.message: Saved, but Firefox has not granted $ORIGIN$. Add it to host_permissions and reload the add-on.

permissionNeeded.message: Quick Add needs permission to read this shop page. Click the toolbar button again and choose Allow. Firefox reported: $ERROR$

noProductInformation.message: No product information was found on this page.

notProductPage.message: This page does not appear to be a product page.

firefoxBlockedAccess.message: Firefox blocked access to this page. Wait until it has finished loading, then click the Quick Add toolbar button again. Firefox reported: $ERROR$

couldNotExtract.message: The product could not be extracted.

unsupportedPage.message: This type of Firefox page cannot be scanned.
